introduction.text: The Capanna Protostorica is a reconstructed Iron Age hut that provides insight into late 9th‑century BC life in the ancient city of Fidenae, near Rome.

history.description: The original hut dates to the late 9th century BC, during the Iron Age.
The site was discovered in 1988, revealing well‑preserved remains.
Excavations were conducted from 1991 to 1993, uncovering posts, wall fragments, pots, and a brazier.
In January 2020, the reconstructed hut was damaged by an accidental fire.

design.description: The reconstruction uses the same construction techniques and materials as the original Iron Age hut.
